text:
maya_support: Hey team — multiple customers reporting console panels returning empty frames and the analytics API returning 500/504 intermittently. Started ~10:02 UTC. Seeing it across orgs, not just one account.

sam_sre: Can you paste one request id or a sample curl that reproduces it?

maya_support: here's a sample from a user's browser console: 
```
POST /v1/analytics/query HTTP/1.1
Host: analytics.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
{
  \"query\": \"SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE ts > now() - 1h GROUP BY service\"
}
```
Response: 504 Gateway Timeout, body: \"upstream request timed out\". Request-id header: rid=svc-20260314-9a3f.

kevin_runtime: Thanks — I just checked traces for rid=svc-20260314-9a3f: backend aggregator v2 is returning 500 at the join stage, stack shows `QueryFanOutTimeoutError`.

ingest-bot: Notice: ingest pipeline backfills job #742 completed at 09:58 UTC (duration 11m). No obvious errors.

sam_sre: Is this coincident with the rolling deploy earlier? deploy-bot: Deployed analytics-aggregator:v2.7.8 at 09:45 UTC by ci/cd pipeline (sha: a1b2c3).

maya_support: A few customers reported gradual degradation then hard failures. One said graphs showed stale data then blank.

kevin_runtime: Hypothesis: long-running fanout queries are hitting our per-request join timeout (default 10s) after the new aggregator change altered parallelism. Will try increasing join timeout on a canary pool.

sam_sre: Can you share a reproducible small query and curl we can run from prod shell? Also please attach client shortid and workspace id for affected accounts.

maya_support: Provided workspace IDs in the ticket: W-9812, W-1203. Repro curl (from user's network):
```
curl -X POST https://analytics.redwood.ai/v1/analytics/query \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"query":"SELECT service, count(*) FROM events WHERE ts > now() - 30m GROUP BY service ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10"}'
```
kevin_runtime: Ran the same from our debug pod against canary pool — got 500 with similar join timeout after ~11s. Increasing join timeout to 20s on canary resolved the 500, returned results in ~13s.

sam_sre: Good repro. Rollback option: revert aggregator change (v2.7.8 -> v2.7.7) or tweak timeout/parallelism. Which is safer short-term?

kevin_runtime: Short-term patch: bump join timeout to 20s and drop per-query parallelism slightly for the hot path. Will also add a fallback to aggregate partial results instead of failing whole query.

maya_support: TL;DR for customers: intermittent dashboard blanks and 500/504s caused by aggregator join timeouts after today's deploy; eng working on mitigation. I posted a support notice on status.redwood.ai and created ticket #SUP-3921. Can we add a recommended temporary mitigation (client-side)?

sam_sre: Recommend: set console refresh to lower frequency, and on dashboards use `max_time_window` shorter windows (30m) as temporary mitigation to reduce fanout. Also advise customers to retry once; we will not auto-retry at gateway level to avoid overload.

kevin_runtime: I'll push the timeout bump to prod canary now, monitor error rate and tail latencies. If error rate drops we'll promote.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled: analytics-aggregator timeout patch -> prod-canary at 10:20 UTC.

maya_support: Thanks. I'll update customers and link to incident ticket. If anyone finds a related billing/auth issue while debugging, ping here.

customer_ops: Just FYI — one enterprise account hit alert and opened a priority support case. They asked for ETA.

sam_sre: ETA: 30–45m for mitigation verification and customer-facing update. Will post in this thread with metrics once canary results are in.

kevin_runtime: Canary deployed, monitoring dashboards: error rate down 86% for the affected queries so far. Continuing to watch KV cache hit ratios and mem usage.

maya_support: Posting update to customers now with the workaround and ETA. Closing loop when promote completes or rollback needed. :thumbsup:
